name: Nastassia Ivanova
original_name: ナスターシャ・イヴァノワ
source:
A surface pilot in the Zhar Battalion. She serves as Latrova’s XO and as a squadron commander, despite being only in her late teens. Good at her job, but when she gets excited her youthfulness shows itself. Respects her superior officer, Latrova, like a mother.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
